Notify: inputs for your test-authorization proposal (seat 2 will not run its own). These are the tests seat 2 hits that only Sam or hotlong can run today: (1) `workflow_dispatch` of golden-journey.yml on a branch, refused by the relay, whose allow-list is only shard-timings-refresh.yml and release.yml on main; (2) signed-in staging browser reads (cloud#3504, #3342: a maintainer session in the browser pane); (3) the first run of governed workflows after merge (#3746 staging migrate, #3753 install-kit acceptance, the ee-v4.3.1 digest); (4) production deploy approvals (held by Sam's 「生产环境还是等等」). Candidate levers: widen the relay's workflow_dispatch allow-list to named read-only/staging workflows; a dedicated staging test account whose credentials are a repo secret NAME, used by a workflow and never by a seat; keep production behind the Environment approval.
